angle_name: Canonical signed-renewal contraction via the von Mangoldt derivative identity
mechanism: Write ΔR(m)=1_P(m)−(Li(m)−Li(m−1)), so S_y(u)=Σ_{dm≤u,d≤y} μ(d)ΔR(m) exactly. Replace 1_P by Λ/log plus the explicit prime-power correction, dyadically Abel-sum the slowly varying 1/log weight, and complete each resulting μ×Λ hyperbola only while retaining signs. The complete part collapses through μ*Λ=−μ·log; the complementary part is therefore a signed dilation operator with kernels Σ_a μ(a)log(a)F(⌊u/a⌋), rather than an absolute renewal edge. Apply this identity simultaneously to the multiset u=X−t, 0≤t<W, and to its exact quotient descendants, using a scale-normalized Carleson energy on that canonical dilation tree. Prove that the normalized signed operator has norm at most 1−η on the actual residual, with the affine component kept explicitly. Absorbing the contracted descendant energy gives the required root-window mean square. Prime powers are retained as a separate squareful forcing term: their elementary absolute bound has size X^(3/4+o(1)) pointwise, already compatible with rung 1, while rung 2 requires signed treatment of that forcing as well.
new_leverage: This uses the one opening left by obstacle 9: μ*Λ=−μ log turns the completed hyperbola into a signed derivative kernel before any inequality is applied. The canonical backward average supplies a Hilbert-space norm in which genuine contraction can be asked for, while the quotient-descendant tree prevents generic exceptional windows from being smuggled in. Thus the proposal neither recombines Mertens moments nor takes absolute values over renewal edges.

target_estimate.name: Canonical Signed-Renewal Carleson Contraction, CSRC(η)
target_estimate.statement: Let I0 be the multiset {X−t:0≤t<W}, with X=(y+1)^2−1 and W=y+1, and let T(I0) contain precisely the quotient multisets generated from I0 by the dilation arguments occurring in the exact Abel–von Mangoldt completion. With E(I,F)=|I|^−1 Σ_{u∈I}|F(u)|²/u^(1+ε), prove for the exact normalized signed renewal operator K from that completion that E(I0,KF)≤(1−η)sup_{I∈T(I0), I≠I0}E(I,F)+C_ε, uniformly in y, for the actual prime-centering residual F; also prove root energy O(X^ε) for the exact prime-power and Abel-weight remainders. The resulting absorbed inequality is W^−1Σ_{t<W}|S(y,X−t)|²≪_ε X^(1+ε).

obstacle_positions.1_F_closure: No bound for ΣM(d)² is inserted and no CS/Hölder step separates μ from the prime residual; μ remains inside the signed convolution and renewal operator.
obstacle_positions.2_fiber_growth: No pair-to-modulus map or bounded-fiber assertion is used; the geometry is the exact quotient-dilation tree of the t-window.
obstacle_positions.3_pinned_vs_averaged: Only the specified backward window at X=(y+1)^2−1 and its forced quotient descendants are averaged; no generic-x exceptional-set theorem is invoked.
obstacle_positions.4_modulus_magnitude: The wheel modulus never appears; all conductors or dilation parameters are at most y and arise from the Abel hyperbola.
obstacle_positions.5_parity: This is not an upper-bound sieve: the parity-sensitive μ×Λ sign is preserved through μ*Λ=−μ log. Establishing strict contraction is exactly the unresolved parity-bearing step.
obstacle_positions.6_circularity: No pointwise estimate for R and no zero enumeration is assumed. A successful contraction would prove, rather than import, the corresponding zero-free consequences.
obstacle_positions.7_finite_range_deception: Numerics are used only for the kill test and parameter diagnosis; neither a finite singular-value gap nor the reported calibration is evidentiary.
obstacle_positions.8_Wigert_floor_jump: Pointwise smoothness is never requested. The exact affine component is retained, divisor spikes are paid inside window energy, and only the proved affine/amortized modulus is used.
obstacle_positions.9_renewal_telescope: The complete telescope is used solely to expose μ*Λ=−μ log; the complementary edge is never bounded absolutely. CSRC is precisely the signed contraction required to reopen this door.

kill_test: Derive the exact finite renewal matrix for one smooth dyadic Abel block and the canonical window, including its forced normalization and affine projection. Test its action on dilation modes F_s(u)=u^s and compute the exact finite singular value for increasing y. If a stable low-Mellin mode has normalized gain at least 1, or the gain approaches 1 with no compensating cancellation between adjacent Abel blocks, then a uniform η cannot hold and the angle should be killed before attempting zero-density or spectral machinery.
rung1_version: Prove CSRC with any fixed η>0 but allow total forcing energy O_ε(X^(3/2+ε)). The elementary squareful bound already fits this allowance, and absorption would give W^−1Σ|S|²≪X^(3/2+ε), hence the honest fixed saving S≪X^(3/4+ε), i.e. δ=1/4 up to ε.
plausible_partial: An exact, Lean-formalizable Abel-to-signed-renewal decomposition on the canonical backward window, together with an O_ε(X^(3/2+ε)) window-energy bound for the prime-power correction and a proof of CSRC after removing a finite low-Mellin-frequency subspace. This would isolate the obstruction to a small explicit family of slowly varying dilation modes instead of the full two-parameter hyperbola edge.
weakest_assumption: A uniform strict L2 contraction, with some η>0, only for the exact signed renewal operator acting on the actual residual along the canonical quotient-descendant tree; no contraction for arbitrary functions or generic windows is required. For rung 2, the squareful remainder must additionally have critical energy O_ε(X^(1+ε)).
